title: Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO after resignation
h1: Nvidia's board has voted unanimously to bring Jensen Huang back as chief executive, less than two weeks after he resigned
description: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23, 2026 to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and president. Its internal investigation of Huang continues.
standfirst: The board reversed course days after saying it did not intend to reinstate him. President Trump endorsed the decision, and Huang is expected to testify before Congress next week.
keywords: Jensen Huang reinstated, Nvidia CEO, Nvidia board vote, Harvey Jones Nvidia, Colette Kress CFO, Nvidia investigation, Nvidia November 2026
takeaways: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23, 2026 to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO and president.
As recently as November 17, the board had said it did not intend to bring him back.
The board's internal investigation continues, and Huang is expected to testify before congressional committees next week.
body: Nvidia's board voted unanimously on Monday, November 23, to bring co-founder Jensen Huang back as chief executive, president and a board director, NPR reported. The Associated Press, in a report carried by PBS News, called the decision a surprise that came shortly after the board had turned down Huang's offer to return.

"The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers," board Chairman Harvey C. Jones said in a statement quoted by the AP.

Huang resigned earlier this month after reports that he had an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. As recently as November 17, the board said it did not intend to reinstate him, though Huang had said publicly that he would come back if the board allowed it, according to NPR.

The company's statement said the vote followed a series of conversations and meetings, along with input from people at senior levels of the U.S. government, NPR reported. The board said its meetings with Huang left directors satisfied with his candor and his ability to lead the company.

President Donald Trump endorsed the move. He said the federal government had no reason to believe Huang's return poses a national security risk, both outlets reported. Trump also said that, according to Attorney General Todd Blanche, the United States does not have evidence that Huang broke the law, and that Nvidia should keep examining its own compliance with U.S. export controls, according to NPR.
The reinstatement does not end the matter. The internal investigation the board opened is still under way, NPR reported, and Huang is expected to testify before congressional committees next week.

Colette Kress, who served as interim chief executive, will go back to her job as chief financial officer, the AP reported. Nvidia shares rose sharply on Monday morning, as did the broader stock market, according to NPR.
In his own statement, Huang thanked employees, shareholders and his family. "I can't wait to get back to work," he said, according to the AP.

faq.q: Is Jensen Huang CEO of Nvidia again?
faq.a: Yes. Nvidia's board voted unanimously on November 23, 2026 to reinstate him as chief executive and president, NPR and the Associated Press reported.

faq.q: Is the Nvidia investigation of Jensen Huang over?
faq.a: No. NPR reported that the company's internal investigation continues, and Huang is expected to testify before congressional committees next week.
